svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 05 · Los Angeles · 11/12 The View West (Common)
svg.desc: From the top of the hill the sky goes gold to the west, where the ocean hides in the haze. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
